name: task_benchmark_v1
status: pre-registered: written before any benchmark or pilot run; not to be edited after runs start (a revised set gets a new name)
purpose: Task-level answer correctness of the Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat int8 model under LeanMoE (expert cache + prefetch) and Windows paging (memory-mapped, no cache, no prefetch). Execution consistency (identical tokens) is a separate, earlier claim and is not used to score answers.

design.generation: greedy (argmax), chat template of the store, stream_generate, stop at <|im_end|> / <|endoftext|>
design.time_limit_definition: per request: from the start of stream_generate (prefill included) to the final token; model load excluded. A request over the limit still runs to completion and is scored, but does not count as 'correct within the time limit'.
design.hard_cap_definition: safety stop: a request still running after 300 s is cancelled at the next token boundary and scored as not correct (status 'cancelled').
design.memory_budget_note: LeanMoE cache sized by the engine's normal budget calculation (budget minus estimated rest of process), as in eval/config_compare.py; the memory-mapped mode uses the same budget value for its startup guard.
design.process_layout: one fresh child process per (task, mode): load the model, request 1 = 'first request' (first request after load), request 2 = 'warm repeat' (the same prompt again in the same process). Scores and timings of the two are reported separately, never averaged together.
design.order: tasks in the listed order; LeanMoE first for even task positions (0, 2, ...), Windows paging first for odd positions; one process at a time
design.prompt_suffix: Keep your reply short. End with a final line of the form: Answer: <your answer>

answer_field: The text after the last 'Answer:' (case-insensitive; markdown * and _ around it ignored) up to the end of that line. If there is none: 'manual review' when the reply ended normally (end-of-sequence), 'incorrect' when it was cut off (token limit), cancelled or errored.
number_parsing: Unicode minus normalised to '-'. A fraction a/b counts as its value. Thousands separators (17,532) accepted. Numbers compared with tolerance 1e-9.

rules.last_number: correct if the last number in the answer field equals the expected value; manual review if the expected value appears in the field but is not the last number; otherwise incorrect (including no number).
rules.root_set: correct if the set of values written as 'x = <number>' equals the expected set, or the set of all numbers in the field equals it; manual review if every expected value appears in the field but neither set matches exactly; otherwise incorrect.
rules.choice: correct if the field names the expected option and none of the wrong options; incorrect if it names only wrong options (or none); manual review if it names the expected option and a wrong one. Matching is whole-word; case-insensitive unless 'case_sensitive' is true.
